title: Windows: Quit from tray now exits reliably
highlights: Windows: 'Quit Entanglo' from the system tray now exits the process reliably. The 0.1.56 fix used Task.Delay().ContinueWith() as a watchdog, but ContinueWith continuations are scheduled on the WinUI DispatcherQueue — which does not pump messages when the app window is hidden and the tray icon is the only UI. The watchdog therefore never fired. Replaced with a raw OS Thread (no DispatcherQueue dependency) that calls Environment.Exit(0) after 2 s unconditionally.

Windows: installer no longer gets stuck when upgrading over a running build. A PrepareToInstall step now runs taskkill /F before copying any files, so the old process is gone before the new one is installed regardless of whether Quit is responsive.

All fixes from 0.1.56 are included: connection stability on minimize/background, real LAN latency display (~1 ms instead of ~903 ms artefact), controller mode (edge switching to Mac), and fast auto-reconnect.
